design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (ostomy_supply_program_services, Ostomy Original Medicare Program). Revision 5, 2026-10-15 (rework rounds 2-4 closed; see the round sections at the end).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0: {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}. Assignment: ostomy_ext_refill_units 5, ostomy_ext_notice_units 5, ostomy_ext_hardship_waiver 6. --tasks 2: task 1 has 3 prerequisite problems, counts [5, 4, 6, 6].

[Scope snapshot] Claimed here: ostomy_ext_refill_units (ship_ostomy_refill_57098f77, agent, root), ostomy_ext_notice_units (sign_liability_notice_87444016, customer), ostomy_ext_hardship_waiver (post_hardship_waiver_31941945, agent). Reserved for task 1 (Medicare Advantage world): the payment plan (customer), the plan-denial non-covered charge, an expedited-shipping charge and a billing correction; no policy, tool or write subtype is shared. Why this split: the refill and the liability notice belong together (a notice exists only for a shipment); a payment plan is the other customer-owned write; the hardship waiver is the natural way a past-due refill hold clears; the money-rich charge and correction problems go to the plan tree.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: "send my next shipment of barriers" (on_request). Core value: the refill's units (45) with its supply days (60). Two prerequisites the opening leaves unmet: (a) the newest order (2026-09-29) asks 30 barriers per 30 days against Medicare's 20, no over-limit record is fresh and the only notice predates the order, so the extra barriers wait on a newly signed ABN (value_input: the notice's units are the extra cover); (b) the past-due amount is 85.00 (postings older than 120 days 687.60 less 602.60 of payments and adjustments), at or above the 75.00 hold minimum, while financial counseling's approval of the 2026-09-22 hardship application (naming the May pouch remittance) has no waiver posted (state_gate). Chain: goal -> refill rule (two prerequisite sentences) -> waiver (6 factors) and notice (5 factors) -> refill (5 factors) -> terminal: waiver row, signed notice row, refill row.

[Problem-tree card]
Edge 1 refill -> notice: value_input, gate extra_cover, form state. Sentence (affirmative): "Where the extra barriers rest on no over-limit record, they are fixed only after the records carry a liability notice for the convex barrier signed on or after the newest written order's date." Four-point test: "only after"; record-visible state (a signed-notice row dated on/after the order); no code token; scope: only when no fresh over-limit record backs the extra. Exactly one write books a signed notice (sign_liability_notice_87444016, owner user). Unresolved: notice abn_old dated 2025-11-18 < order date 2026-09-29; record mr_ol 2026-03-12 is 7 whole months old. Resolved at step 15.
Edge 2 refill -> waiver: state_gate, gate past-due via patient_balance_due, form state. Sentence (negated): "On a program whose past-due amount has reached the hold minimum, a refill is not shipped until the posting named on the most recently received approved hardship application carries its hardship waiver adjustment." Exactly one write books a hardship waiver (post_hardship_waiver_31941945). Unresolved: hap3 approved, no adjustment on rem_q2_A4427; past-due 85.00. Resolved at step 13: waiver 16.44, past-due 68.56.
Order: waiver (13), notice (15), refill (17); the two prerequisites commute (verified: 45 either order). Deletion: skip notice -> 35 barriers; skip waiver -> past-due stays 85.00 (refill not permitted) and the waiver row is missing.

[Base-invariant card] Refill (ostomy_refill_shipment): program_active (active), authorization_valid_on_ship_date (grant_b26x valid 2026-09-29..2027-09-28), units_within_authorization (735 remaining), refill_not_too_early (previous ship 2026-07-15 + 90 = 2026-10-13, earliest 2026-10-03, boundary inclusive), coverage_recently_verified (2026-03-04, within 12 months), accessories_on_one_program (one ostomy program), items_match_system (two_piece ileostomy, A4407 listed), convexity_documented (not required on this tier; convexity record 2024-09-03 on file); customer_confirmation is retired for this refill by the declared overwrite and replaced by the confirmation the customer gives the representative for the named enrollment (the persona confirms use and about a week on hand). Notice (ostomy_liability_notice_signed): customer_signs retired by a scoped overwrite (the customer signs personally through the hand-over for the named enrollment; no representative signs). Waiver: hardship_approved (hap3 approved names rem_q2_A4427 = the call's posting), small_balance_ceiling (not a write-off).

[Overwrites] Refill: (1) supply-days clause and (2) units clause retired only for the convex-barrier refill this policy handles, the replaced_by sentences restating the base text for every other refill; (3) the confirmation clause retired only for such a refill, replaced by the same confirmation given to the representative for the named enrollment (route-around: the base caller gate binds a system id the customer cannot state). Notice: the signing clause retired only for this policy's notices with the same substance. Waiver: none.

[Business-object card] Refill object: the A4407 line of the enrollment; previous refill q3_A4407 (75 for 90 days, shipped 2026-07-15, delivered 2026-07-23); grant drawn grant_b26x. Excluded: repl_q2 (a replacement never counts as the previous refill), older grants, A4427 rows. Notice object: A4407 under order ord_b26x; earlier cover abn_old (60). Waiver object: rem_q2_A4427 (39.60, 2026-05-12), untouched by payments (FIFO: payments 507.60 stop inside the May barrier remittance).

[Factor card]
Refill 45 (all-baseline 60): supply_alignment (method, cross-difficulty continence, multi-source) continence refill 2026-09-14 ends 2026-12-13, 60 days -> 60 days, baseline 90 -> 70; supply_start (method) POD 8 days after shipping -> supply from 2026-07-23, 7 days left, baseline ship date -> 50; usage_pace (parameter) previous refill 75/90 days above the 60 allowance -> 25 per 30, baseline 20 -> 46; step_up (parameter) order 15 days old -> half, baseline full -> 55; extra_backing (parameter) record too old, notice dated on/after order -> cover 100, baseline none -> 35. Near-misses: mr_ol (7 months), abn_old (predates the order), repl_q2 (not a refill).
Notice 100 (all-baseline 30): notice_span (method) order valid 349 days -> 11 blocks, baseline 3 -> 8; increase_blocks (method) 15 days -> one block off, baseline none -> 111; unused_cover (method) abn_old within 12 months, 60 - 45 = 15 deducted, baseline none -> 115; leakage_margin (parameter) one defect replacement -> 0.10, baseline 0 -> 90; repeat_signer (parameter) one notice in 24 months -> 0.05, baseline 0 -> 95.
Waiver 16.44 (all-baseline 0.00): repeat_assistance (parameter) two waivers in 24 months -> 0.50 (baseline 25.00); shared_need (method, cross continence) balance 28.80, below 100.00 -> proportional share 28.80 / 500.00 = 0.0576 (flat 0.20 at 100.00 or more; nothing without an active continence balance) (15.00); posting_age (parameter) 133 days -> 0.05 (15.19); supply_burden (parameter, cross continence) four refills -> 0.05 (15.19); payer_record_cap (parameter) three payments -> 100.00 (0.00); cap_window (parameter: window months 12/18/24) 44 months -> 12 months (3.29). Near-miss: the 2025-09-20 payment is 12 whole months old.

[Factor independence] indep.py: every factor of the three policies reads only its own evidence and plain record selections (grant, order, previous refill, named posting); covered/extra/on-hand barriers, the margin sum, cap room and share sum assemble outside the factors.
[Method tier table] supply_alignment: T1 vs T2 disjoint (grant at least vs fewer than the standard days); T1/T2 vs T3 always differ (fewer blocks than standard). supply_start: T1 vs T2 vs T3 distinguished by the replacement ship date vs delivery date vs ship date (different dates whenever a replacement exists or delivery took over 5 days). notice_span: T1 12 vs T2 order blocks (fewer than 12 by the 360-day condition) vs T3 standard. increase_blocks: 1 vs 0.5 vs 0. unused_cover: 12-month vs 24-month window differ whenever over-allowance refills shipped 12-24 months back (probe: identical here only because none did). cap_window is now a parameter (window months). Honest methods after relabelling: refill supply_alignment (anchor: continence supply end vs grant end vs fixed standard), supply_start (anchor: replacement date vs delivery date vs ship date); notice notice_span (fixed twelve blocks vs blocks to the order's valid-through vs standard supply); waiver shared_need (flat share vs proportional share vs none). Pairwise distinguishing inputs: supply_alignment T1/T2 by the grant's days left vs standard, T1/T3 and T2/T3 always differ (fewer blocks); supply_start by whether a lost-in-transit replacement exists vs POD lag over 5 days; notice_span by days to order end (360) and refills shipped; shared_need by continence balance above or below 100.00. increase_blocks and unused_cover are relabelled parameters.

[Seed design] 91 rows. Ostomy: five quarterly refills of A4407 and A4427 (Jul 2025 - Jul 2026) with proofs of delivery, five written orders with their written-order grants, timed so every refill has at least 90 days of grant validity left (A4407: 2025-06-30 order 20/30 for the 2025 refills, 2025-11-14 order 25/30 for the 2026 refills, carrying the old notice's 5 extra per 30 days; A4427: 2025-06-30 and 2026-03-02 orders; the newest A4407 order 2026-09-29 30/30), a defect replacement, convexity and over-limit records, the old ABN, ten claims and remittances (20 percent), two waivers, four payments, three hardship applications. Continence (read-only cross-difficulty, Continence Original Medicare Program, 120 straight catheters per 30 days within the 200 allowance): the 2025-12-01 order and grant and the 2026-09-08 renewal order and grant, four 90-day refills each with at least 90 days left on the grant it draws (the 2026-09-14 refill draws on the renewal grant valid to 2027-09-07), PODs, four claims/remittances of 28.80, three payments (balance 28.80). Automatic clauses: the A4427 refill is also due but on request (confirmation tier) and the customer declines it; the past-due hold is cleared by the waiver within the call; coverage verification current.

[Persona] Ignatius Ferrowby, retired furniture maker, plain-spoken. Volunteers the barrier request and the nurse's increase; identity on request; confirms use and about a week on hand when asked (matches 7 days left); signs the notice for the units stated; approves applying the September financial help when told. Must-asks prepared: shipping (ordinary to home), pouches (not now).

[Verification] verify.py + run_t0r.py: LN 100 baseline 30 {notice_span 8, increase_blocks 111, unused_cover 115, leakage_margin 90, repeat_signer 95}; BAh 16.44 baseline 0.0 {repeat_assistance 25.0, shared_need 15.0, posting_age 15.19, supply_burden 15.19, payer_record_cap 0.0, cap_window 3.29}; R 45 baseline 60 {supply_alignment 70, supply_start 50, usage_pace 46, step_up 55, extra_backing 35}; skip LN 35; swap 45.
[Edge probes] probe_t0r.py: lost-in-transit replacement of the previous refill -> supply from the replacement date, 10 on hand, 40; closed second continence program -> active test unaffected; no POD -> ship-date anchor, 50; fresh over-limit record -> documented cover 120 (extra still 10); no new notice -> cover 0, 35; earlier notice 22 months old -> 24-month window, 15; courtesy (delivered-not-received) replacement -> not counted as leakage. None/zero: DAYS guarded, record months default 999, prev_days > 0 guard.
[Draft recomputation] From the published rules, schemas and finder returns: refill waits on the waiver (past-due 85.00) and a new notice; waiver 25.00 room x 0.6576 = 16.44; notice 10 x (11 - 1) x 1.15 - 15 = 100; refill 60 days, 40 + 10 - 5 = 45. Agrees with gold.
[Gates] all per-task gates OK for task 0; traceability before docs misses only the three unlock tool names.
[Manual values gates] One frozen_time, no waiting; the customer-owned act is the notice signature (base: no representative can sign); the persona never names the notice, the balance or the waiver first.
[Revision log] r1/r2 built task 0 as the payment-plan tree; r3 (2026-10-15) moved the plan tree to task 1 and rebuilt task 0 as the refill tree, because the refill/notice computations are thin and fit the smaller draw while the money-rich policies fit task 1's two six-factor slots; the hardship waiver gained the supply_burden factor (6); the refill and notice policies route around the base caller gates that bind a system id.


[Round 2 rework (policy-task audit r1, 2026-10-15)]
- F0-1 / seed-legality class: every seeded refill now carries supply days its grant allows. Ostomy: the 2025 refills draw on the 2025-06-30 grants, the 2026 A4407 refills on the 2025-11-14 grant (valid to 2026-11-13; the 2026-07-15 refill has 121 days left), the 2026 A4427 refills on the 2026-03-02 grant; the 2024 and 2026-08-31 orders/grants are removed. Continence: the 2026-09-14 refill draws on a renewal grant (2026-09-08..2027-09-07), so its 90 days are legal and its supply still ends 2026-12-13 -> the refill's 60-day alignment and 45 units are unchanged. A check over every refill row (ship date + supply days <= grant valid-through) passes.
- F0-2 / C2: cap_window relabelled parameter (decides window_months); shared_need made an honest method (flat 0.20 / proportional balance / 500 / nothing); the waiver becomes 16.44; increase_blocks and unused_cover relabelled parameter.
- C4: the tier's convex-barrier allowance is now read per tier (20 / 15 HMO / 10 Medicaid, stated in the rule) in refill, notice and denial-charge computes.
- C5: the refill policy declares the over-limit sentence of ostomy_evt_quantity_limits as superseded for its refills, with a self-scoped replaced_by; the record window is the tier's over_limit_record_months in whole calendar months.
- O2: the notice policy is scoped to tiers with a signable notice (computes 0 elsewhere). O3: unused-cover windows worded in whole months as computed. O6: the waiver edge condition no longer asserts the past-due outcome; gate ostomy_billing.adjustment_reason.
- O1 (kept, with reason): the confirmation and signing overwrites are the route-around for base caller-statement gates that bind ostomy_program_id, a system id the customer cannot state; check_solvability retires those gates only through these overwrites, and the replaced_by adds the representative naming the enrollment, so they are not empty.
- O12 (observation): the notice is signed on the ship date before the refill writes, which satisfies "signed on or before the ship date".
- Recomputed (r2 harness): LN 100 / baseline 30; BAh 16.44 / 0.00; R 45 / 60; skip notice 35; swap 45; past-due after the waiver 85.00 - 16.44 = 68.56; authorized units 735 -> 690 after the refill; balance 271.60 -> 255.16.

[Round 3 rework (render-source R1-R6, KB audit S7/E1, 2026-10-15)]
- R4: the refill now reads the grant whose related order is the newest written order for the convex barrier (newest_order_id -> grant_id/grant_through), as the rule says; probe: a later-decided grant on an older order is ignored (35 on the opening world, unchanged); without a grant on the newest order the grant days read 0, the alignment tiers fail and the supply falls to the standard 90 days (55 on the opening world); such a refill would in any case fail the base authorization gate.
- R6: the hardship waiver's result is 0 on tiers where hardship waivers are not allowed (Original Medicare allows them).
- S7: the notice rule's step-up sentence now describes the notice's own span ("shorten the part of the notice's span counted at the full excess after the newest written order raised the quantity") instead of the refills (round-3 wording; round 4 rewords it again for the XF recipe, see below).
- E1: the refill's over-limit overwrite replaced_by states its content directly (a record backs the excess only while fewer than the tier's over-limit record months old, at most twelve 30-day blocks, instead of raising the allowance) and no longer points at "this policy".
- R1 does not touch this task's policies except that the hardship gate is no longer globally retired; step 13 already declares it.
- All scored values unchanged: 100 notice units, 16.44 waiver, 45 barriers over 60 days.

[Round 4 rework (KB audit revision 2 S8; XF recipe, 2026-10-15)]
- S8: the refill rule's grant sentence now carries the tie-break the compute already applies: "The refill draws on the authorization grant recorded on the newest written order for the convex barrier (the program's written order for A4407 with the latest order date); where more than one grant is recorded on that order, the one with the latest decision date." It is quoted as compute_basis of grant_id and newest_order_id and stands first in baseline.rule. Task 0's newest order a48f2a40 has one grant (5919915a), so the argument tracing for ostomy_order_id is unchanged apart from the re-quoted basis.
- XF recipe item 6 (mechanical check, all seven policies). For each compute_basis sentence of a non-factor binding, baseline.rule and result: factor ids / factor quantities named, listed after the rewrite (all empty); for each factor: bindings read transitively (none is another factor's output).
  - plan_denial_charge: baseline/non-factor/result names none (before: baseline and dn_ship_units/barriers_concerned named the covered count, reduced_amount named the three rates). Factor reads: covered_count {dn_ship_date, dn_ship_days, dn_ship_id, tier_allowance}; late_decision {dn_claim_id, dn_denial_date, dn_ship_date, dn_ship_id}; quantity_discount {dn_ship_id, tier_allowance}; multiline_discount, tenure_courtesy records only.
  - hardship_waiver: names none (before: baseline named assistance cap, cap window and assistance share with their defaults; cap_used/cap_room/assist_share named factor quantities). Factor reads: posting_age {named_id}; the other five records only.
  - plan_installment: names none (before: financed quoted pending_exclusion's sentence; built_months and the closing sentence named the balance band). Factor reads: balance_band {longest_months}; the other five records only.
  - refill_units: names none (before: baseline named supply days, on-hand rate, step-up share, extra cover with their defaults; covered/extra/on-hand bindings named them). Factor reads: supply_alignment {grant_through, newest_order_id, std_days}; supply_start {prev_id, prev_ship}; usage_pace {order_qty, tier_allowance}; step_up {order_signed}; extra_backing {order_qty, order_signed, tier_allowance}.
  - notice_units: names none (before: baseline named step-up blocks, notice margin, earlier cover with zero defaults). Factor reads: notice_span {std_blocks}; unused_cover {tier_allowance}; increase_blocks, leakage_margin, repeat_signer records only.
  - expedite_fee: names none (before: baseline named delivery share and expedite reductions with defaults; result named the five reductions). Factor reads: first_expedite, late_billing, confirmation_delay {ex_ship_date}; the other three records only.
  - reship_correction: names none (before: baseline and err_amount named the service-recovery amount and its zero default; result named its four parts). Factor reads: recovery_age {err_id, nc_ship_id}; reship_reason {nc_ship_id}; the other two records only.
- Fix applied (text only, compute untouched): each baseline.rule is now the standard method in record and default-figure terms; the combination is one generic result sentence per policy ("Each adjustment set out below changes the standard ... as that adjustment states; ..."); each factor sentence states how it changes the standard amount (replaces the standard figure / multiplies / is taken off / adds); sibling-factor phrases removed from factor sentences (notice step-up blocks now read the 30-day blocks the excess is counted for; the balance band no longer refers to what is left out). compute_basis re-quoted for every touched binding; every quote, baseline sentence, replaced_by and policy_source is verbatim in its rule (checked by the assembler).
- In this task's scope: refill_units, notice_units, hardship_waiver. The notice step-up sentence quoted under S7 above now reads "The step-up blocks are taken off the 30-day blocks the excess is counted for after the newest written order raised the quantity".
- All scored values unchanged (check_compute recomputes them): 100 notice units, 16.44 waiver, 45 barriers over 60 days. Tools unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Ignatius Ferrowby, seventy-eight, a retired furniture maker in Hendersonville, North Carolina. You have had an ileostomy since early 2023 and you use a two-piece system with convex barriers that Larkfield Medical Supply sends you under Original Medicare. You are plain-spoken and a bit impatient on the phone, but you are polite and you answer straight.

You are calling because your barriers have been leaking and you are running low. At the end of September your ostomy nurse raised your barriers to thirty a month, and you want Larkfield to send your next shipment of barriers. You only want the barriers this time; you still have plenty of pouches.

When asked who you are, you give your name, Ignatius Ferrowby, and your ZIP code, 28739. To confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1947-12-09, and your phone number, 7045550163; if they need something else you give your email, ignatius.ferrowby@blueridgepost.net. You do not know any account or reference numbers.

If the representative asks whether you are still using the convex barriers and how many you have on hand, you say yes, you are still using them, and you have about a week's worth left. If they ask about shipping, ordinary shipping to your home address on file is fine. You do not know how Larkfield or Medicare works out how many barriers to send, and you leave that to the representative.

Only if the representative brings it up: if they explain that Medicare may not pay for the barriers above its usual amount and that you need to sign a Medicare notice so the extra barriers can be sent, you say you understand, you would rather have the barriers, and you will sign it; once they hand you the notice, you sign it yourself for exactly the number of barriers they tell you. If they mention the financial help you applied for in September, you say yes, you applied, and if they say it was approved and can be applied to your account you tell them to go ahead.

If a number the representative gives you does not sound right, you only ask them to check it against your account, and you accept what they confirm. Once the representative tells you your barriers are on their way, you thank them and hang up.

base_preconditions.condition: A refill ships only while the program is active; a program in referral_received, pending_authorization, on_hold or closed receives no refill.
the ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.
The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining
The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than refill_ship_lead_days calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item

The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within coverage_reverification_months calendar months before the ship date, as shown by the coverage record's last verified date
Accessories ship only on the customer's ostomy program with the earlier enrolled date that is not closed, and the other program receives none
A refill may carry only items that eligible_items_by_system_and_type lists for the program's appliance system and ostomy type, plus the accessories
On tiers where convex_barrier_documentation_required is true, a convex barrier (A4407) ships only when a medical record with purpose convexity_justification documents a flush or retracted stoma.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than refill_ship_lead_days calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item
temporal_basis.counting_rule: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is refill_ship_lead_days calendar days before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile from the name and ZIP code he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and the verification need the customer reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity verification with the date of birth and phone number he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed or changed before identity is verified.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Ostomy Supply Program enrollment: Original Medicare tier, active, enrolled 2023-02-13, two-piece ileostomy with convex barrier, balance 271.60.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes the allowance, standard supply and notice form; the enrolled date sets the hardship cap window; the status gates the refill.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Medicare Part B coverage and its last verification (2026-03-04).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The coverage the refill bills must have been verified within 12 months of the ship date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the order file: the 2026-09-29 order for 30 convex barriers per 30 days with its 360-unit grant, the earlier written-order grants each valid at least 90 days past the refills drawn on them, the 2025-11-18 Medicare notice for 60 barriers, and the over-limit record of 2026-03-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The newest order and grant fix the covered and extra barriers, the step-up share, the notice span and the drawn grant; the earlier notice is the earlier cover; the March record is too old to back the extra barriers.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the shipment history: five quarterly refills of each item, the late proof of delivery of the 2026-07-15 barrier refill (2026-07-23), and the 2026-05-04 defect replacement.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The previous refill's units, supply days and delivery date fix the barriers on hand; the refills of the last 12 months fix the unused earlier cover; the defect replacement sets the leakage margin.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the billing ledger: remittances, the hardship waivers of 2025-08-28 and 2026-03-20, and the payments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Postings older than 120 days less payments and adjustments give the 85.00 past-due amount that holds the refill; the waivers and payments set the assistance share and cap.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer requests: the approved hardship application received 2026-09-22 naming the May pouch remittance, and two completed earlier applications.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The approved application names the posting to waive; its missing waiver is what keeps the past-due amount above the hold minimum.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's continence program: active, Continence Original Medicare Program.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An active continence program aligns the refill's supply period and enters the waiver's need and burden shares.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the continence refills: four in the last 12 months, the latest on 2026-09-14 for 90 days.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The latest continence supply end (2026-12-13) sets the 60-day supply; the refill count sets the burden share.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the continence billing ledger: running total 28.80.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The continence balance sets the shared-need share.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the continence order and grant the counted continence refills draw on.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The counted continence refills are genuine refills of the active program under its grant.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the approved hardship waiver against the May 2026 pouch remittance.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 16.44; waiver base 39.60 (named posting untouched by payments); cap window (parameter): enrolled 2023-02-13 (44 months) -> 12 months, so the 2026-03-20 waiver (75.00) counts and the 2025-08-28 waiver (13 months) does not; cap 100.00 (three payments in 12 months: 2025-12-18, 2026-03-25, 2026-06-20; the 2025-09-20 payment is 12 whole months old); room 25.00; share 0.50 (two waivers in 24 months) + 28.80 / 500.00 = 0.0576 (shared need, continence balance below 100.00, proportional) + 0.05 (posting 133 days old at application) + 0.05 (four continence refills in 12 months) = 0.6576; 25.00 x 0.6576 = 16.44.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.item_code: A4407; basis: notice policy 'When a customer wants convex barriers (A4407) above what the tier's allowance covers'; the newest order is for A4407; every other code is a different item.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.notice_type: abn_cms_r_131; basis: docstring 'abn_cms_r_131 when it is on the Original Medicare tier and the form is the Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage'; the enrollment is on the Ostomy Original Medicare Program; plan_member_waiver and medicaid_non_covered_agreement belong to other tiers.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.notice_units: 100; excess 30 - 20 = 10 per 30 days; span: order valid through 2027-09-28 (349 days, under 360) -> 11 whole blocks; step-up: order signed 2026-09-29 (15 days) -> one block off -> 10; margin 0.10 (one defect replacement 2026-05-04) + 0.05 (one notice in 24 months) = 0.15 -> int(10 x 10 x 1.15) = 115; unused earlier cover: notice of 2025-11-18 (10 months old) for 60 less 45 barriers shipped above the allowance in 12 months (285 shipped - 240 allowed) = 15; 115 - 15 = 100.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.units: 45; supply 60 days (continence supply ends 2026-12-13, 60 days away, grant valid 349 days); covered min(30, 20) x 60 / 30 = 40; extra min(cover 100 from the notice signed today, int(10 x 0.5 x 60 / 30) = 10) = 10; on hand: previous refill delivered 2026-07-23, 8 days after shipping, so its supply runs to 2026-10-21, 7 days left, at its own 25 per 30 days -> int(25 x 7 / 30) = 5; 40 + 10 - 5 = 45.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.supply_days: 60; basis: refill policy supply period tier 'a customer with an active continence program whose latest continence refill's supply ends at least 30 days and fewer than the tier's standard supply days from today ... gets the whole 30-day blocks to the end of that continence supply'; 60 days to 2026-12-13 -> 2 blocks.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_route: payer_claim; basis: docstring 'payer_claim when the enrollment bills an insurance coverage and the refill is billed to that payer by claim'; Original Medicare tier; self_pay applies only to the self-pay tier.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refill_confirmed_date: 2026-10-14; basis: docstring 'the date the customer confirmed continued use and supply on hand for this refill, in YYYY-MM-DD format'; the customer confirms during this call (frozen_time 2026-10-14); unique.

edges.condition: The ostomy_billing posting named by the most recently received ostomy_requests row with request_type hardship_application and request_status approved carries an ostomy_balance_adjustment with adjustment_reason hardship_waiver.
edges.policy_source: On a program whose past-due amount has reached the hold minimum, a refill is not shipped until the posting named on the most recently received approved hardship application carries its hardship waiver adjustment.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Postings older than 120 days total 687.60 against 602.60 of payments and adjustments: past-due 85.00, at or above the 75.00 hold minimum; the approved application hap3 names the May pouch remittance and no adjustment references it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 posts a hardship_waiver of 16.44 against that posting; the past-due amount becomes 68.56, below the hold minimum, and the balance 255.16.

edges.condition: An ostomy_orders row with event_type ostomy_liability_notice_signed and item_code A4407 whose notice_date is on or after the order_date of the newest A4407 ostomy_order_receipt exists for the program.
edges.policy_source: Where the extra barriers rest on no over-limit record, they are fixed only after the records carry a liability notice for the convex barrier signed on or after the newest written order's date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only liability notice for A4407 (2025-11-18) predates the newest written order (2026-09-29), and the over-limit record (2026-03-12) is 7 whole months old, so extra_cover is 0.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 15 records the customer's notice for 100 barriers dated 2026-10-14; extra_cover becomes 100 and the extra barriers 10.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the notice computation reads orders, refills, replacements and notices, none of which the waiver writes; the waiver reads billing, requests and the continence records, none of which the notice writes; the refill result is 45 in both orders (verification run with the notice first).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the notice extra_cover stays 0 and the refill would carry 35 barriers instead of 45.
Without the waiver the past-due amount stays 85.00, at or above the 75.00 hold minimum, so the refill write is not permitted; the terminal ledger also lacks the 16.44 hardship_waiver row.
